ctx.x: But none of the other places had funerals, with music.
Yeah, yeah, they didn't have none in my home flat, none of the bad drugs, they didn't have none. Shreepo, oh yeah, that was the phone.

Oh yeah, you see, Shreveport, they never had no music for funerals around there at all, but they heard it by New Orleans. A lot of fellas coming down there and they'd see them funerals down there, you know, and some of them would remember. Well, they had a, he was a veteran from the Spanish-American War way back then. And it was his request to have some kind of music when you die, you know. So everybody knew I had been down this way, living down this way. They say, look, we got to have some kind of music at the…
